sentences.text: The Crime and Corruption Commission surveyed employees across Queensland’s public service departments to understand perceived corruption risks and attitudes to reporting and prevention.
sentences.support:
to better understand their perceptions of corruption risks and attitudes towards 
reporting and preventing corruption.

sentences.text: The anonymous online survey ran in May and June 2021 and received answers from more than fourteen thousand employees across 19 departments, including hospital and health services but excluding police.
sentences.support: The online survey was open for a six-week period between May and June 2021.

sentences.text: The CCC reported that 65% believed corruption occurred in Queensland’s public service, compared with 22% who believed it occurred in their own work unit.
sentences.support:
Two-thirds of respondents (65 per cent, n = 8678) 
agreed

sentences.text: The CCC identified concerns about reprisals and management inaction as barriers to reporting, despite widespread willingness to report suspected wrongdoing.
sentences.support: Several barriers to reporting corruption were identified by respondents.

sentences.text: The CCC urged departments to support reporting, review relevant controls, maintain accessible guidance and provide continuing education about potentially corrupt conduct.
sentences.support:
Public service departments should ensure they foster an environment that encourages and supports the 
reporting of suspected wrongdoing.

findings.quote:
Public service departments should ensure they foster an environment that encourages and supports the 
reporting of suspected wrongdoing.

Departments should ensure their corruption prevention 
resources are accessible, informative, and up to date.

notes: WHAT WE FOUND is the factsheet's findings overview. Percentages use valid responses to individual questions; departmental response rates ranged from 2% to 25%. Advice is unnumbered. The source records 14 452 respondents; the summary uses a rounded lower bound because digit grouping prevents the gate recognising a comma-formatted total.
